notes: 0.20.0-beta.3: Stage 5 beta 3, the last of Stage 5. The Library (a new menu item): Patient forms, Procedure forms, Setup sheets, SOPs and Files, search in both languages, print any document blank or several together as a packet, an English/Spanish switch, uploads of PDFs and photos (migration 20). Setup sheets: a Setup sheet column and single-code links in Settings → Procedure forms, the Setup tag on the schedule, every sheet for an appointment under a header with the patient's alerts from Open Dental, Today's setups by operatory. Permissions Edit library (managers) and Edit setup sheets. Diastema's generic starters: 13 consents, 7 before-visit pages and 15 aftercare pages in English and Spanish, drafts to take or ignore; nothing is sent until the office publishes its own. SOP owners, review dates and required reading come with Compliance.
